Start from each `Lessons` record; combine it with each `Staff` record for which staff id (`Staff.staff_id`) equals staff id (`Lessons.staff_id`), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); combine it with each `Addresses` record for which address id (`Addresses.address_id`) equals staff address id (`Staff.staff_address_id`), one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); group the kept records by staff id (`Lessons.staff_id`) and state or province (`Addresses.state_province_county`); each group gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) staff id (`Lessons.staff_id`); (2) state or province (`Addresses.state_province_county`); (3) the number of records in the group.
Step 2. Start from the rows of step 1; group the kept records by column (2) of step 1; each group gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) column (2) of step 1; (2) the sum of column (3) of step 1 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 3. Start from the rows of step 2; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the sum of column (2) of step 2 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 4. Start from the rows of step 2; combine it with the rows of step 3 for which it is not true that column (1) of step 3 is missing, one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); for each kept record, return (1) column (1) of step 2; (2) column (2) of step 2; (3) A ÷ B. Here A is column (2) of step 2; B is column (1) of step 3.
Step 5. Start from the rows of step 4; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the average of column (3) of step 4 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).
Step 6. Start from the rows of step 4; combine it with the rows of step 5 for which it is not true that column (1) of step 5 is missing, one combined record per match (a record without a match is dropped); keep only the records for which column (3) of step 4 is greater than column (1) of step 5; for each kept record, return (1) column (1) of step 4; (2) column (2) of step 4; (3) column (3) of step 4; (4) A − B. Here A is column (3) of step 4; B is column (1) of step 5.
Step 7 (the answer). Start from the rows of step 6; all kept records form one group, which gives one result row; for each result row, return (1) the average of column (2) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (2) the average of column (3) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none); (3) the average of column (4) of step 6 in the group (missing values ignored; missing when there are none).

examples.construction: agg:Staff within Addresses.state_province_county > share:all > baseline:all > agg:g > agg:all
why: share of the all total of number of Lessons records (all level)
gap to the all average of number of Lessons records: share of the all total (all level)
coarsen to g: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
coarsen to all: SUM (additive), AVG (averaged), AVG (averaged)
examples.sql: WITH "s1" AS (SELECT "Lessons"."staff_id" AS e, "Addresses"."state_province_county" AS g, COUNT(*) AS m1 FROM "Lessons" JOIN "Staff" ON "Staff"."staff_id" = "Lessons"."staff_id" JOIN "Addresses" ON "Addresses"."address_id" = "Staff"."staff_address_id" GROUP BY "Lessons"."staff_id", "Addresses"."state_province_county"), "s2" AS (SELECT SUM("s1"."m1") AS v FROM "s1"), "s3" AS (SELECT "s1"."e" AS e, "s1"."g" AS g, "s1"."m1" AS m1, (CAST("s1"."m1" AS REAL) / "s2"."v") AS m2 FROM "s1" JOIN "s2" ON "s2"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s4" AS (SELECT AVG("s3"."m2") AS v FROM "s3"), "s5" AS (SELECT "s3"."e" AS e, "s3"."g" AS g, "s3"."m1" AS m1, "s3"."m2" AS m2, ("s3"."m2" - "s4"."v") AS m3 FROM "s3" JOIN "s4" ON "s4"."v" IS NOT NULL), "s6" AS (SELECT "s5"."g" AS g, SUM("s5"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s5"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s5"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s5" GROUP BY "s5"."g") SELECT SUM("s6"."m1") AS m1, AVG("s6"."m2") AS m2, AVG("s6"."m3") AS m3 FROM "s6"
